rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and ZIP, matching a single user before accessing orders. It located the correct tablet order, provided the correct tracking number from tool data, and sought explicit confirmation before each order-changing action (exchange attempt, return of tablet, cancellation of pending charger order, and return of delivered sneakers). When the exchange was unavailable, the agent appropriately offered a return instead. All actions were supported by tool results, performed on the authenticated user’s orders, and aligned with order statuses (delivered returns, pending cancellation). Final confirmations and outcomes (refunds to the gift card and return instructions via email) were consistent with tool outputs. No unsupported claims or premature writes occurred.
